name: RAPT Pill - Chart Plotter
description: Interecepts telemetry data from https://app.rapt.io/devices/list and plots the data in a separate JSON Panel. The plot is designed to be much more readable than the default plot on rapt website. Enable the extension and load the https://app.rapt.io/devices/list to get a replacement plot. Please change the resolution (Ctrl + Scroll) to adjust the size of the graph to your liking.
